newsitem.title: CHINA: Jin Jiang Tower 1996 net up 0.92 pct.
newsitem.headline: Jin Jiang Tower 1996 net up 0.92 pct.

text.p: (in millions of yuan, unless stated, against 1995 figures)
Net assets per share 4.19 yuan vs 4.44 yuan
Earnings per share 0.155 yuan vs 0.169 yuan
Company name: Shanghai Jin Jiang Tower Co Ltd
Note: The results were contained in the firm's 1996 annual report published in the Shanghai Securities News on Monday. All figures are based on domestic accounting standards.

The company did not give net profit figures based on international accounting standards. However, the firm posted pre-tax profit of 75.242 million yuan for 1996 against 86.887 million yuan for 1995 under international accounting standards.
The company's board of directors proposed a one-for-10 bonus share issue for shareholders based on 1996 net profit and another one-for-10 bonus issue from the firm's reserves.
The proposal depends on the approval of shareholders at the company's 1996 annual meeting scheduled for May 28, a statement said.
